section: 7/1/2024Enacted by Chapter 259, 2024 General Session2024Reports of illegal product.If the commission suspects that an electronic cigarette product or a nicotine product is being sold in the state in violation of a law other than a law described in this part, the commission shall report the name of the seller, the type of product, and the county where the product was sold:to the local health department for the county where the sale occurs;the Department of Health and Human Services; andthe Department of Public Safety.
